diagrams.title: Before: short synchronous drafting
diagrams.description: Client asks the single application to generate and commit a short supplier draft. No durable worker queue exists.

diagrams.title: After: durable execution path
diagrams.description: Trusted API commits job to host-local durable Queue. A separate worker claims an epoch, runs bounded tools, and commits a scoped result. Identity and provider remain fixture boundaries.

diagrams.title: Execution sequence and crash boundary
diagrams.description: Accept, claim, execute, recover, commit, and inspect. Safe work may redeliver; external ambiguity is quarantined; stale completion is rejected.

lab_assumptions: Logical clock; worker stops at time zero. Safe pure work may redeliver. A started external effect requires reconciliation. Zero recovery seconds for unknown means no automatic recovery, not immediate success.
